arStrings.szText: Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage increased.

{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/c}{/u} you for {c_number}[{SF_34} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * SF_34)|0|]){/c} over its duration and forms a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/u}{/c} every second.

{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} becomes a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds.

Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, {c_important}Blood Mist{/c} consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[SF_31|1|]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals Shadow damage.

{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} now deals {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_DOT_SHADOW}{/c} Shadow damage over its duration and applies {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse{/c}{/u} to enemies.
{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|+%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance for {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} seconds after it ends.
{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} seconds.

{if:SF_33}{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} every second.{else}{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} after you teleport.{/if}
{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} and Slows them by {c_number}[{SF_27}|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} seconds.
